pageDescription: Accounts, entries and balance of your club.
emptyDescription: Create an account and record income and expenses – the balance updates automatically.
addTransactionFirstHint: Create an account first – then you can record transactions.
emptyHint: Collected fines can be booked directly as a transaction on an account.
accountModalDescription: Manage income and expenses in a dedicated account.
deleteAccountConfirm: Delete account “{name}”? This is only possible while it has no entries and no fines.
selectAccountHint: Choose an account from the list to view its transactions.
txDescriptionPlaceholder: What for? e.g. clubhouse room rental
noTransactions: No transactions. Add your first transaction.
ownOnlyDescription: Your fines: lateness and absence and tasks completed late.
allDescription: All fines of the club: lateness and absence from the minutes and tasks completed late.
noFinesDescription: Fines arise from a protocol's attendance tracking, or can be added manually here.
noFinesHint: Lateness and unexcused absences can be booked automatically per protocol.
deleteReasonDescription: The fine for {name} comes from a finalized protocol. It is not removed permanently but listed with the reason in the protocol in which it is deleted.
deleteReasonHelp: Shown in the protocol and in the export.
createFineDescription: Assign a fine to a protocol and a person.
tariffDescription: Applies to every attendance block with “Fines active” switched on, unless its template has its own rates.
tariffAccountHelp: Without an account no fines are created.
tariffSaveFailed: Fine rates could not be saved
tariffNotSet: No fine rates set – attendance blocks create no fines.
accountDeleteConflict: The account still has transactions or fines and cannot be deleted.
txLockedByFineConflict: This transaction belongs to a collected fine. Please reopen the fine instead of changing the transaction.

todoFines.description: Fines for tasks completed late. While a task is open, the fine keeps running. On completion the amount is frozen and can be collected.
todoFines.ownOnlyDescription: Your running and frozen fines for tasks completed late.
todoFines.readOnlyNotice: The task fines module is switched off. Existing fines remain visible, no new ones are created.
todoFines.conflictBanner: {count, plural, one {Several rules match # task.} other {Several rules match # tasks.}} Please assign the fine manually.
todoFines.daysLate: {count, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}

todo.label: Fine
todo.saveFailed: The fine could not be saved.
todo.conflict: Several rules match ({rules}). Please set the fine manually.

state.no_rule: No rule matches, no fine applies.
state.rule_missing: The selected rule no longer exists.
state.none: No fine applies to this task.
state.no_due_date: No fine without a due date.
state.no_assignee: Nobody is responsible, so no fine applies.

todo.loadFailed: The fine could not be loaded.
todo.rulesLoadFailed: The rules could not be loaded.
todo.frozenHint: Frozen: stays when the task is reopened, rescheduled or deleted. Only someone who manages finances can change or waive it.
todo.runningHint: The fine keeps running until the task is done. The fined person can then no longer change the due date or assignees themselves.
todo.applyHint: “Apply” saves only the fine, immediately and independently of the rest of the form.
todo.applyInvalid: Please choose a rule or enter a valid amount first.

todoFines.ruleInUse: {count, plural, one {The rule is assigned to # task by hand} other {The rule is assigned to # tasks by hand}} and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.

help.appliesFrom: The rule applies to tasks due on or after this date.
help.filter: Every filled-in filter type must match; within a type one match is enough. Empty filters do not restrict. If several rules match, a conflict arises.
help.interval: Fine = base amount + the interval amount for each full interval. Example 2 days, 5.– + 2.–: 1 day late 5.–, 2 days 7.–, 5 days 9.–.
help.split: “Each person pays in full” or the amount is divided by the number of assignees.
help.conflict: Several rules match this task. No fine arises until someone with finance rights sets it by hand.
help.todoFine: While the task is open and overdue, the fine keeps running. On completion it is frozen per person and stays afterwards.
help.mode: Automatic by rules, a specific rule, a fixed amount or no fine. For a completed task, open frozen fines are recalculated (in the audit log).
help.template: A template sets the interval and suggests amounts: “Fixed amount per day” charges the same amount for every day late, “Base amount + per week” charges a base amount from the first day plus a surcharge for every full week.

todoFines.tariffDeleteConfirm: Delete tariff “{name}”? {count, plural, =0 {} one {# person falls back to the default tariff.} other {# people fall back to the default tariff.}}
todoFines.tariffsDescription: Tariffs such as apprentices or full earners. Each tariff has its own amounts for lateness and absence and in every task rule. Anyone without a tariff pays according to the default tariff.
todoFines.membersDescription: People without their own tariff pay “{name}”.
todoFines.tariffNameHelp: For example apprentices, non-earners or full earners.
todoFines.defaultTariffLabel: Default tariff for people without their own tariff
todoFines.filterSummaryPackages: {count, plural, one {# task package} other {# task packages}}
todoFines.rulesDescription: Rules apply automatically to late tasks that match the filter. If several rules match, a conflict arises and the fine is assigned manually.
todoFines.needTariffFirst: First create at least one tariff under “Tariffs”.
todoFines.appliesFromHelp: Only tasks due on or after this date.
todoFines.filterHelp: Empty = no restriction. Within a filter one match is enough; all set filters must match.
todoFines.intervalHelp: {count, plural, one {The additional amount is added for every day late.} other {The additional amount is added for every # full days late.}}
todoFines.splitHelp: Applies when a task has several people responsible.
todoFines.intervalAmount: {count, plural, one {Additional per day} other {Additional per # days}}
todoFines.ruleDeleteConfirm: Delete rule “{name}”? Fines already fixed remain.

splitHint.each: Every responsible person pays the full amount of their tariff.
splitHint.split: The amount is split evenly among the responsible people.

todoFines.defaultHint: Applies to everyone without their own tariff.
todoFines.defaultLockedHint: This is the default tariff. Set another tariff as default to change it.
todoFines.defaultReplaceHint: Replaces “{name}” as the default for everyone without their own tariff.
todoFines.templateHint: Prefills the interval and amounts for all tariffs. You can adjust everything afterwards.

todoFineRunningHint: Running until the task is done

fineSettings.description: How much fines are: for lateness and absence, per tariff and for tasks completed late. The fines themselves are listed under Finances > Fines.
fineSettings.attendanceDescription: Club tariff for attendance blocks with “fines active”: account and amounts for lateness and unexcused absence.
fineSettings.attendanceTariffHint: Set own amounts per tariff (e.g. apprentices) in the “Tariffs” tab. A minutes template can override the club tariff; its amount then applies to everyone.
fineSettings.tariffAmountsHelp: Leave empty to use the club tariff. Amounts for tasks are set in the task rules.

errors.fine_transaction: This entry belongs to a collected fine. Reopen the fine under “Fines” instead of changing the entry.
errors.todo_fine_transaction: This entry belongs to a collected task fine. Reopen the fine under “Fines” instead of changing the entry.
errors.protocol_finalized: This entry belongs to a finalized protocol and can no longer be changed. Record a correcting entry instead.
errors.account_not_empty: The account still has entries or fines and cannot be deleted.
errors.conflict: The change is not possible because the data has changed in the meantime. Please reload.
errors.readOnly: Finances are read-only in your plan. Changes are no longer possible.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.invalid: Please check your input (amount and description).

locked.label: Locked entry
locked.fine: Belongs to the collected fine of {name}. Change it via “Fines → Reopen”.
locked.todoFine: Belongs to the collected task fine of {name}. Change it via “Fines → Reopen”.
locked.protocol: Belongs to a finalized protocol. Correct it with a counter-entry only.
locked.protocolNumber: Belongs to finalized protocol {number}. Correct it with a counter-entry only.

readOnlyBanner: Finances are read-only in your plan: accounts, entries and fines remain visible, changes are locked.
provisionalHelp: Sum of fines still open (attendance and task fines) that will be booked to this account when collected. It is not yet included in the balance.
lockedHelp: Entries with a lock belong to a collected fine or a finalized protocol and cannot be changed directly.
currencyHelp: Applies to all accounts and fines of the club. Only a label (e.g. CHF, EUR, Fr.): hocX does not convert amounts.
finesHelp: Open fines are carried over to the next protocol. Collecting books the amount to the fines account, reopening undoes it. Fines deleted later need a reason.
noTransactionsReadOnly: There are no entries on this account yet.
reopenConfirm: Undo the collection of {amount} for {name}? The finance booking will be deleted and the fine is open again.
currencyFromSettings: All accounts and fines use the club currency {currency}. It is set in the organization settings.
